_about: The AISC brand theme (Luxembourg AI Factory): the values every app's :root carries, and the fonts. Layouts are each app's own; only these change. scripts/tests/test_brand_theme.py holds every app to them.
rules: body text in Raleway; h1-h4 in MuseoModerno, color var(--heading); ids, labels and code in IBM Plex Mono
no blueprint grid behind the launcher pages
an app sets only the variables it uses, each to the value above
every app's top header: 89px tall (20px padding top and bottom, 40px left and right, 1px bottom border), the logo 48px tall, the product title 19px MuseoModerno 700 in sentence case
